date: # Public driverless (no safety driver) ride-hailing open to the general public: date it opened to all.

note: first public rides with no safety monitor in the car (Musk on X, 22 Jan 2026, as reported); only part of the Austin fleet at first. The 22 Jun 2025 launch was invite-only with a safety monitor; the app opened to all on 4 Sep 2025 (https://www.insurancejournal.com/news/southcentral/2025/09/05/837907.htm), still with monitors
